scope: Portable statistical-unit observations, all completed timing stages including the initial failed control; not individual-hop samples. Full per-hop samples and infrastructure journals retained in the local evidence archive.
block_definition: Each variant has two fresh processes per mirrored block. Take arithmetic mean of its two run means, then log(candidate/baseline). Projecting each contrast gives ABBA/BAAB.
analysis: Use tools/compare_benchmarks.py statistical functions. Student t CI uses alpha=.05/family_size. Conditional assignment randomization uses the observed ABBA count and analysis_seed, with20,000 bootstrap resamples before20,000 Monte Carlo assignments where exact enumeration exceeds20,000. Adjust p by family_size capped at1.
